ModMetaData.name: Slave Outfits [1.7]
ModMetaData.author: Usgiyi
ModMetaData.description:
V1.7.4 10/16/26 Do you have a bunch of slaves/prisoners wearing the same clothes as your colonists? Did your inner slaver get triggered because you just can't find proper a uniform mod? Give your beloved prisoners the outfits they deserve at last! Concentration camps not included.
This is a really basic mod that adds some apparel for slaves and prisoners.
Updated to 1.0 and beyond by Usgiyi.
V1.7.4 10/16/26 Rimworld 1.7 V1.7.3 8/19/25 Odyssey update. Spacer suit now has vacuum resistance. V1.7.2 6/18/25 Changed a description. Updated to 1.6 V1.7.1 3/13/24 Touched up art, removed rogue coloring outside the outline of clothes. Added black outlines to hats as suggested by Arky. Doubled resolution of clothing. Fixed off center clothing sprites. Rebalanced clothing cost and stats. Fixed missing tech level for spacer uniform, thanks for pointing it out Vartarhoz. V1.7 10/22/22 Hats no longer cover legs, as the workaround is no longer needed since 1.3. Added some 1.3 tags. Rebalanced stats of clothes, as a consequence the cosmetic version of the mod will be depreciated. Switched to default Rimworld apparelbase defs. Increased resolution of and touched up the female and hulk servant outfits and the bandana. V1.6.1 7/25/21 Added SlaveSuppressionOffset to clothes. V1.6 7/21/21 Added 1.3 to supported versions. Moved clothes to vanilla research. Fixed defName naming convention. Finally removed depreciated workbench.
